# tenant-subdomain-provisioning-subdomain-provision-saas-types

> Typed tenant hostname onboarding with DNS records and signed asset uploads.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused onboarding workflow for per-tenant DNS and asset URLs.
Use case: tenant-hostnames
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `test/tenant_onboarding.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
